info.title: Score C# callables using cyclomatic complexity and source-bound coverage

options.name: --root
options.description: [default: .]

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Score threshold [default: 10, or the config value]

options.name: --format
options.description: [default: text] [possible values: text, json, sarif]

options.name: --sort
options.description: Text report order: `location` (scan order) or `crap` (highest first) [default: location, or crap with --top] [possible values: location, crap]

options.name: --top
options.description: List at most N callables in the text report

options.name: --failing-only
options.description: List only callables above the threshold in the text report

options.name: --no-require-coverage
options.description: Override a config `require_coverage: true`

options.name: --no-fail-on-empty
options.description: Override a config `fail_on_empty: true`

options.name: --jobs
options.description: Worker threads for scanning [default: available parallelism]

options.name: --define
options.description: Conditional compilation symbol for files that do not parse as written (repeatable; comma- or semicolon-separated lists are accepted)

options.name: --skip-unparsed
options.description: Skip files that still do not parse instead of failing the scan

options.name: --no-skip-unparsed
options.description: Override a config `skip_unparsed: true`

options.name: --partial-unparsed
options.description: Score the intact callables of files that still do not parse, instead of failing the scan or skipping the whole file

options.name: --no-partial-unparsed
options.description: Override a config `partial_unparsed: true`

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Compare with this baseline: only new or worse violations fail [default: the config `baseline`]

options.name: --no-baseline
options.description: Ignore a baseline set in the config

options.name: --write-baseline
options.description: Write the current violations to PATH as a baseline; exits 0 unless `--require-coverage` or `--fail-on-empty` fails

options.name: --overwrite-baseline
options.description: Replace an existing `--write-baseline` file

options.name: --baseline-move
options.description: Match baseline entries of file OLD against file NEW (root-relative; repeatable)

options.name: --changed-since
options.description: Score only selected files that differ from the merge base of REV and HEAD, including uncommitted and untracked files (needs `git`)

options.name: --config
options.description: Read this `dotnet-crap.json` instead of discovering one in the root

options.name: --no-config
options.description: Do not read any `dotnet-crap.json`

options.name: --no-ignore
options.description: Do not honor `.gitignore` and `.ignore` files

options.name: --include
options.description: Keep only files matching this root-relative glob (repeatable)

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Drop files matching this root-relative glob (repeatable)

options.name: --help
options.description: Print help

options.name: --version
options.description:
Print version
Fresh coverage collection: dotnet-crap collect --help
